target.meaning: Target MAC normalized by trimming, lowercasing and converting hyphens to colons.

flags.meaning: The flags.exousia.pin value carries the administrative PIN, never in command-line arguments; local verifier accepts a nonempty string at most 512 bytes. Other flags shapes supply no PIN. On a remote target the extracted PIN is forwarded, including null when absent. The entire raw POST body is at most 4096 bytes and is refused when the exact byte sequence "pin": occurs more than once.

ok.meaning: The outer relay completed, even if a target entry signals failure.

answers.meaning: Entries contain mac, hostname, proven, signal and answer; signal can be null or a peer/local outcome and answer can be null. A proven remote POST includes peerStatus, the parsed HTTP status as an integer or null.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed literal outcomes are enumerated; The enum lists fixed top-level refusals. Peer reply and nested answer signal can pass through arbitrary peer text; remote path also records a Hyalos deed.
